pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

head.desc: the head: big blue eye with lashes, rosy cheek, golden fringe; pivot at the neck (0, 16)

head_blink.desc: eye shut; pivot at the neck (0, 16)

head_talk.desc: mouth open; pivot at the neck (0, 16)

hair.desc: long golden hair down the back, behind the head and dress; pivot at the crown

tiara.desc: the tiara: a gold band with the seventh piece, a curved golden plate; pivot at its foot on the head

tiara_glow.desc: the tiara blazing (raise the tiara); pivot at its foot on the head

dress.desc: the gown: cream bell skirt with a waffle-grid panel, gold trim, a whipped-cream ruffle hem; bodice with a gold neckline and a chocolate-glaze sash, bow at the back; root card, pivot (0, 1)

arm_front.desc: the front arm: a cream puff sleeve with gold trim and a long white glove; pivot at the shoulder

arm_back.desc: the back arm, a tone darker: a cream puff sleeve with gold trim and a long white glove; pivot at the shoulder

feet.desc: two gold slippers peeking from under the hem; pivot between them
